terra.problem: The closing line about respecting a gate with a reason is repetitive and flat.
The comparison does not fit: a sign saying someone will be back in five minutes does not suggest unfinished construction.
The chocolate-chip dive compares Papa's play to Ezekiel falling before the glory of the LORD. It makes the sacred moment the setup for a joke.
The passage says Ezekiel saw the glory and fell facedown; it does not say he was wide awake.
Even as a guess, the explanation supplies a reason why the LORD asks Ezekiel to use his eyes and ears that the text does not give.
Saying their job is not the priest's work is broader than the text. It specifically forbids them to approach God to serve Him as priests and to come near His holy things.
The passage says the Israelites went astray, but it does not say everyone else wandered.
The passage says these priests kept charge of the sanctuary; it does not explicitly say they did not run.
